business_summary.text: Fairchem Organics processes waste from edible-oil refining (acid oil, deodorizer distillate) into oleochemicals such as linoleic acid, dimer acid, isostearic acid and glycerine for paints, inks, cosmetics and animal feed.

call_points.text: Business benefited from improved price realization and lower raw material costs during Q2.
Current capacity utilization is around 60% to 65% and is expected to improve.
Reduction in import duty on Crude Soybean Oil from 16.5% to 11% will improve raw material availability.
H1FY27 revenue rose 41.4% on higher price realisation from costlier raw material and imported finished product.
Management is 'consciously optimistic' on utilisation for the year, citing the US tariff, EU/UK FTA and the soya oil duty cut.
Exports are targeted to rise initially by 25% and eventually to 50% of sales, helped by the US tariff and proposed EU/UK FTA.
Management flags uncertain macros from the Middle East crisis while staying optimistic on tariffs and FTAs.
Paint segment demand has started seeing a robust recovery during March and the current quarter.
Management targets reaching 8% EBITDA margins for FY27.
The bypass fat plant is expected to start operations next month, with revenue contribution from Q3.
